<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Series RLC · Step Response</title>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;padding:0;min-height:100%;box-sizing:border-box;background:#0c0c10;color:#ececf0;font-family:ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif}
*{box-sizing:inherit}
#app{display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:100vh;height:100dvh}
#stage{position:relative;flex:1;min-height:0;overflow:hidden}
canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;touch-action:none}
#hud{position:absolute;top:10px;left:12px;max-width:min(460px,calc(100% - 24px));padding:10px 14px;background:rgba(13,15,22,.78);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);border-radius:10px;pointer-events:none}
#title{font-size:14px;font-weight:650;letter-spacing:.02em}
#sub{font-size:11px;color:#8b95a7;margin-top:1px}
#badge{display:inline-block;margin-top:6px;padding:2px 8px;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600;border:1px solid;border-radius:20px;letter-spacing:.03em}
#stats{margin-top:6px;font:11px ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;color:#aab3c2}
#readout{margin-top:2px;font:11px ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;color:#dfe5ee}
#legend{margin-top:5px;font-size:10.5px;color:#8b95a7}
.sw{display:inline-block;width:18px;height:0;vertical-align:middle;margin:0 6px 0 10px;border-top:2px solid}
.sw:first-child{margin-left:0}
.sw.vc{border-color:#56d8e4}
.sw.ii{border-top-style:dashed;border-color:#ffb454}
#controls{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 22px;align-items:center;padding:10px 16px;background:#11131b;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.ctl{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex:1 1 190px;min-width:170px}
.ctl .lab{width:14px;font-weight:650;color:#9fb3c8;font-size:13px}
.ctl input{flex:1;min-width:70px;accent-color:#56d8e4;height:18px;cursor:pointer}
.ctl .val{min-width:76px;text-align:right;font:11px ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace}
#presets{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;flex:0 0 auto}
#presets span{font-size:10.5px;color:#77839a}
